what_they_do: FlowGen Labs builds AI agents that live inside a company's existing ERP (SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics 365, QuickBooks, Oracle) and execute finance and operations workflows directly, rather than replacing the ERP. The agents learn a company's actual processes and exception paths from historical transaction data, then run things like cash application (matching incoming payments to invoices), dispute resolution, invoice three-way matching, and month-end close reconciliation. This replaces the manual work finance and shared-services teams do to chase down exceptions, match transactions, and close the books by hand inside SAP/NetSuite screens.
vertical: Enterprise finance ops / ERP automation (order-to-cash, procure-to-pay)
theme_fit_rationale: FlowGen's agents read and write across ERP, banking, and adjacent systems (Salesforce, Workday, SAP Ariba, Coupa) to execute AR/AP, cash application, dispute resolution, and close reconciliation end to end, which is the cross-functional, multi-system workflow pattern Theme 2 describes almost verbatim.

recent_signals.summary: Published "Making wrong actions unrepresentable in a system that writes itself" (author Hemang Rajvanshy), on designing verification mechanisms that constrain agent action spaces while letting agents build the platform itself.

Now listed as an official SAP partner with two separate SAP.com partner pages (ERP modernization / "System Intelligence" and "Autonomous Order-to-Cash"), and is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer, SAP Functional Consultant, and SAP Technical Lead, suggesting active enterprise deployment ramp.
